div.style: background: #f0f4fc; border-left: 4px solid #1e62d0; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 11px; color: #2c3e50;

span.t: Jarak Tempuh (KM Mileage): Menampilkan akumulasi total jarak tempuh (KM) kendaraan saat dilakukan inspeksi ban. Digunakan untuk menganalisis tingkat pemakaian dan daya tahan ban per unit armada dari waktu ke waktu.

Persentase Keausan Ban (%): Mengukur persentase konsumsi alur ban dari kondisi baru hingga aus. Garis kuning (50%) merupakan evaluasi pertengahan umur untuk rotasi ban, sedangkan garis merah (80%) menandakan batas kritis jadwal kanisir atau penggantian ban.

Efisiensi Pemakaian (KM / mm): Mengukur rasio jarak tempuh yang dicapai per 1.0 mm keausan alur ban. Semakin tinggi nilai KM/mm, semakin awet kualitas ban, presisi spooring/wheel alignment, dan efisiensi pengoperasian armada.

Tekanan Angin Ban (PSI): Memantau tekanan angin ban saat kondisi dingin dalam satuan PSI. Garis hijau menandakan tekanan standar (110 PSI), sedangkan garis merah menandakan bahaya tekanan kurang (< 90 PSI) yang berisiko menyebabkan aus tidak merata atau ledakan ban.

Biaya per KM (Est. CPK Rp/KM): Menghitung perkiraan biaya operasional per kilometer (Rp/KM) berdasarkan harga beli ban dibagi proyeksi total umur pemakaian. Membantu optimasi pengadaan barang dan pemilihan merek ban terbaik.

Ketebalan Alur Ban (RTD mm): Memantau sisa ketebalan alur ban (mm) secara berkala. Garis putus-putus merah menandakan batas minimum keselamatan (3.0 mm) untuk rotasi/penggantian ban, sedangkan garis hijau menandakan standar ban baru (18.0 mm).

div.h3: Tire Rotation Telemetry & Fleet Wear Variance Analytics

div.title: Vehicles Analyzed Calculation: Total active fleet vehicles evaluated for tire wear and position variance. Formula: COUNT(Active Vehicles with >= 1 Mounted Tire)
Rotation Needed Calculation: Count of vehicles where tread wear percentage variance across tires is >= 15%. Formula: COUNT(Vehicles where (Max Wear % - Min Wear %) >= 15%)
High Priority Calculation: Count of vehicles with severe tread wear variance (>= 25%) requiring urgent rotation. Formula: COUNT(Vehicles where (Max Wear % - Min Wear %) >= 25%)
Potential Life Extension Calculation: Cumulative distance gained fleet-wide by equalizing tire wear across positions. Formula: SUM(Wear Variance % * 100 KM per tire for vehicles needing rotation)

div.title: Head Units (Prime Movers) Calculation: Total prime mover / tractor vehicles in active fleet. Formula: COUNT(dh.vehicle where is_head = True)
Connected Trailers Calculation: Trailers actively coupled to prime mover head units. Formula: (Connected Trailers / Total Trailers) * 100%
Uncoupled Idle Trailers Calculation: Count of trailers uncoupled or parked at depots. Formula: Total Trailers - Connected Trailers

div.h3: Tire Asset Valuation & Financial Depreciation Analytics

div.title: Gross Asset Value (Gross) Calculation: Sum of original purchase prices / acquisition values of all fleet tires. Formula: SUM(Tire Purchase Price or Original Gross Asset Value)
Accumulated Depreciation Calculation: Total financial depreciation based on physical tread depth consumption (RTD loss). Formula: SUM(Gross Value * (Tread Consumed mm / Original Tread Depth mm))
Net Asset Value (NBV) Calculation: Remaining net book value of active tire capital assets. Formula: Gross Asset Value - Accumulated Depreciation
Asset Health Ratio Calculation: Percentage of initial fleet tire asset capital value remaining unconsumed. Formula: (Total Net Asset Value / Total Gross Asset Value) * 100%
